translation.question: 2025年のイベリア半島大停電を受けて、スペインのペドロ・サンチェス首相は国家安全保障会議の何を招集しましたか？
answer_aliases: 国家安全保障会議の緊急会議
translation.translation_note: Translated 'convene with the National Security Council' as '国家安全保障会議の何を招集しましたか' (what of the NSC did he convene) to naturally prompt for 'emergency meeting'.

backtranslation_en.question: Following the 2025 Iberian Peninsula major blackout, what of the National Security Council did Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez convene?
answer_aliases: Emergency meeting of the National Security Council
